items.question: How long does NDIS registration take?
items.answer: Timeframes vary depending on provider scope, audit pathway, documentation readiness, and external availability. We help you prepare the documentation, coaching, and audit-readiness steps as efficiently as possible.

items.question: Do I need to be a registered NDIS provider?
items.answer: If you support NDIA-managed participants or provide high-risk supports - yes. We can assess your specific situation during a free consultation and advise on the best path forward.

items.question: What's included in the policy pack?
items.answer: 40+ documents covering complaints management, incident reporting, privacy, service agreements, risk registers, and more - all customised to your specific registration groups.

items.question: How does Easy Compliance work?
items.answer: Easy Compliance is our integrated compliance support platform. We configure it for your operations, import your documents, train your team, and provide AI-assisted validation to support ongoing audit readiness.

items.question: What does onboarding cost for Easy Compliance?
items.answer: Onboarding costs depend on the size and complexity of your organisation. Book a free consultation and we'll provide a transparent, no-obligation quote tailored to your needs.

items.question: Can I get help with just one service?
items.answer: Absolutely. Our services are modular - choose exactly what you need, whether it's NDIS registration, bookkeeping, payroll, compliance, or any other service.

items.question: Do you only work with established companies?
items.answer: Both startups and established businesses. We offer adaptable support based on your stage and objectives, from initial company registration to scaling operations.

items.question: How are your consulting services delivered?
items.answer: We provide services via a mix of virtual meetings, in-person sessions where needed, cloud-based platforms, and ongoing digital support - optimised for your convenience.

page_sections.heading: Common Questions About the Training
page_sections.intro: Everything you need to know before enrolling — from curriculum structure to delivery formats and certification.

items.question: Who is this training designed for?
items.answer: This curriculum is designed for Support Coordinators, Specialist Support Coordinators, NDIS providers onboarding new staff, and RTOs seeking a comprehensive, audit-ready training package. It is also suitable for plan managers or allied health professionals who work alongside Support Coordinators.

items.question: What are the 12 modules and how long does each take?
items.answer: The 12 modules cover: (1) Introduction to the NDIS, (2) Role & Responsibilities of a Support Coordinator, (3) NDIS Practice Standards & Code of Conduct, (4) Plan Implementation & Budget Management, (5) Goal Setting & Participant-Centred Practice, (6) Stakeholder & Provider Coordination, (7) Documentation & Reporting Requirements, (8) Risk Management & Incident Response, (9) Complex Needs & Specialist Support Coordination, (10) Cultural Safety & Diversity, (11) Workforce Development & Self-Care, and (12) Audit Readiness & Continuous Improvement. Each module is designed for approximately 2–3 hours of self-paced learning, totalling 24–36 hours across the full curriculum.

items.question: Is the curriculum aligned to the NDIS Practice Standards?
items.answer: Yes. Every module is fully mapped to the NDIS Practice Standards and the NDIS Code of Conduct. The curriculum also references the NDIS Quality and Safeguards Commission requirements, making it suitable for providers preparing for verification or certification audits.

items.question: Do I receive a certificate upon completion?
items.answer: Yes. Individual learners receive a SOL Certificate of Completion upon finishing all 12 modules and assessments. Team and Enterprise packages include branded completion certificate templates your organisation can issue to staff under your own branding. This is a practical completion certificate, not a nationally accredited qualification unless delivered by an authorised RTO under its own scope.

items.question: Can we white-label the content for our RTO or organisation?
items.answer: Absolutely. The Team package includes co-branded materials using your organisation's logo and details. The Enterprise / RTO package includes full white-label rights — meaning all content (workbooks, slide decks, video scripts, assessments) is delivered under your brand with no SOL branding, including LMS integration support.

items.question: What format are the training materials delivered in?
items.answer: Materials are delivered as editable Word documents, PowerPoint slide decks (.pptx), PDF workbooks, and plain-text video scripts. The 1,500+ quiz question bank is provided in a structured format compatible with most LMS platforms (including Moodle, TalentLMS, and LearnDash).

items.question: How soon will I receive access to the materials after payment?
items.answer: For Individual and Team packages, materials are delivered to your email inbox within 1 business day of payment confirmation. Enterprise packages involve a brief onboarding call to apply your branding before delivery, typically within 3–5 business days.

items.question: Can I purchase additional modules or update the curriculum later?
items.answer: All packages include ongoing updates to the curriculum at no extra cost for the duration of your access period. If you require custom modules tailored to a specific disability support type or organisational workflow, this can be scoped as part of the Enterprise package or as an add-on.

items.question: Is there live support or mentoring available?
items.answer: The Team package includes 2 live Q&A sessions with a SOL trainer. The Enterprise package includes a train-the-trainer program and unlimited email support during the initial rollout period. Individual learners have access to email support throughout their 6-month access period.

items.question: What if I need a tax invoice or need to pay via EFT?
items.answer: We can issue a formal tax invoice for any package. If you prefer to pay via EFT (bank transfer) rather than online, please select the Enterprise / Custom package option in the intake form or contact us directly at info@solbusinessconsultant.com.au and we will arrange this for you.

items.question: How do I know which package is right for my organization?
items.answer: The audit pathway (verification vs. certification) depends on the NDIS registration groups you're registering for. Most providers registering for verification-only groups (Tier 1) choose START. If you're providing direct supports (Tier 2) or SIL/SDA (Tier 3), you'll likely need CERTIFIED or COMPLETE. Contact us for a free consultation to determine the right fit.

items.question: What's the difference between verification and certification audits?
items.answer: Verification audits are simpler and faster (6-8 weeks) for providers offering lower-risk services. Certification audits are more comprehensive (10-14 weeks) for direct support providers and require more detailed evidence. The NDIS Commission determines which you need based on your registration groups.

items.question: Can I upgrade mid-process if I realize I need more support?
items.answer: Yes! If you start with START and realize you need more comprehensive support, we can upgrade to CERTIFIED or COMPLETE. You'll pay the difference, and we'll provide the additional documentation and support needed.

items.question: Does the pricing include ongoing compliance after registration?
items.answer: The COMPLETE package includes 12 months of compliance platform access. START and CERTIFIED cover the registration process only. After registration, we offer optional ongoing support (annual reviews, policy updates, training) at hourly rates.

items.question: What if my audit fails or I need to remediate findings?
items.answer: If the auditor identifies non-compliances, all packages include remediation guidance. Additional support beyond the included scope can be arranged at hourly rates. Our goal is your successful registration—we'll work with you through any findings.

items.question: Do you guarantee registration approval?
items.answer: We cannot guarantee NDIS Commission approval (that's their decision), but we ensure your documentation is audit-ready and meets all NDIS Practice Standards. Our process has consistently supported organizations through successful registration.

cards.title: Secure Server Infrastructure
cards.text: Servers are hosted on enterprise-grade infrastructure with redundant backups, firewalls, and DDoS protection. Regular security patches and updates applied.

cards.title: Access Controls

posts.excerpt: See how document collection, compliance reminders, client intake, support tickets, and project tracking can work together in a practical provider operating system.
posts.content:
Automation works best when it removes repeated manual follow-up while keeping the provider in control. For NDIS and service-based businesses, that usually means intake forms, document requests, expiry reminders, client updates, and task visibility.

The goal is not to replace staff judgement. The goal is to make important steps harder to miss: who submitted a document, what still needs review, which service is in progress, and what the client needs next.

SOL builds practical workflows around the provider's actual service model, team capacity, and compliance requirements so the system supports daily operations instead of becoming another admin burden.
